brief.summary_1line: Ravana secures marriages for his family, weds Mandodari, and their son Indrajit (Meghanada) is born amid ominous thunderous cries.

image_candidates.scene_text: Maya the Danava places his daughter Mandodari’s hand into Ravana’s as a sacred fire burns between them in the forest.
The newborn Meghanada roars like thunder in Lanka while startled Rakshasas look on beneath dark clouds.
Ravana enthroned in Lanka among dark, cloudlike Rakshasas while his brothers stand beside him after the city’s capture.
